description:
Welcome to The Solar Lab! We’re Cody, Robbie, and a growing team dedicated to give people confidence going solar. Through honest product reviews and clear, easy-to-understand education, we give you everything you need to make informed decisions and spend your hard-earned money wisely.

We decline all sponsorships from manufacturers, ensuring our reviews stay 100% honest and unbiased. If we recommend a product, it’s because we put it to the test - not because someone paid us to.

If you have an interest in solar, seeing the latest products or are in the market for a solution, you’re in the right place. 

🔔 Subscribe to our channel for honest reviews, advice, DIY videos and more.

👨🏼‍💻Written Reviews & Resources: https://www.thesolarlab.com

📩 Contact us: info@thesolarlab.com

📬 Brands: Want your product reviewed? Contact us at info@thesolarlab.com for shipping details.
